pair_created_by_launchpad.meaning: the pair for the launch token was created by the launchpad contract (creator is the launchpad)

fees_accrued.meaning: swap fees are accrued for stakers through the pair (launchpadFee0/launchpadFee1 nonzero accrual)

assumptions: The attacker's pair creation is performed by an address other than the launchpad contract.
The launchpad falls back to the attacker-created existing pair rather than creating its own.
The scenario is a possible front-run; no concrete observed incident is established.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of fee accrual; launchpadFee0/launchpadFee1 are only stated to be 0 when launchpadFeeDistributor is address(0), so accrual is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized only for the launchpad-created-pair case; the attacker-created-pair zero-distributor path is the root cause, not the desired relation.
Fee accrual is a qualitative Boolean because the report supplies no numeric fee formula.
Whether the launchpad's createPair call reverting with PAIR_EXISTS is guaranteed versus conditional is not fully specified.
